== Summary ==
Decipher's errata for Captain Piett: the entry “Captain Piett” in Decipher's ''Star Wars CCG Glossary'', Version 2.0 (November 1998), PDF page 32. Image for [[Captain Piett (Decipher Errata 1998)]].

Source: [http://decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf swccgglossary.pdf], archived copy [https://web.archive.org/web/20061215115652/http://decipher.com:80/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf 20061215115652]; wiki copy [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf]] (SHA-1 <code>b3838634d3e1379e527f0914f7816f5b0c130c89</code>). The PDF was created on 17 November 1998 (file metadata); the archived copy and the wiki copy are the same file. Cut unchanged from a 300 dpi render of PDF page 32 (pdftoppm -r 300), around the entry's text block with a 6-point margin. The Glossary prints a ruling paragraph under this entry (“This Imperial may take a Probe Droid into hand any number of times during any player's turn.”); it is not part of the game text and is not in the crop. The PDF does not embed its fonts, so the render uses stand-in typefaces; the words, and which of them are italic (only the entry title), are the PDF's.

SHA-1 <code>e033c92edac5286cd4dfcc1c2641ccc02e348fb8</code>, SHA-256 <code>68591aac616c1c885e28dff4e22ba79fd34913c9cf781577754acfb142869699</code>.
